streak_methodology.interpretation: Statistical diagnostic only. It measures realized conditional risk and out-of-sample predictive information; it does not observe or infer investor beliefs.
streak_methodology.sample: All 84 three-stock baskets from nine surviving semiconductor names; 12 monthly staggered cohorts; immediate same-basket reinvestment after every settlement.
streak_methodology.next_D_definition: Scenario D on the note opened after the recorded prior non-D streak.
streak_methodology.one_year_definition: At least one Scenario-D settlement on the same cohort path from inception through the next 252 trading days, inclusive; later settlements are excluded.
streak_methodology.streak_definition: Number of consecutive immediately preceding completed notes whose outcome was not D; A and W both count as wins and D resets the streak to zero.
streak_methodology.information_timing: Price features use the inception close. Historical D-rate features include outcomes settled at that close because reinvestment is assumed to occur after settlement. The forward label excludes that just-settled prior outcome.
streak_methodology.validation: Expanding forward-only 3-calendar-year test blocks. A training row is admitted only when its entire outcome window ends before the first test inception (purged blocking). Logistic models use standardized features and a fixed L2 penalty of 0.01; no test-block tuning.
streak_methodology.dependence_caveat: Baskets, cohorts, and outcome windows overlap. Metrics describe predictive performance on these historical paths and are not independent-observation confidence intervals.
streak_methodology.survivorship_caveat: Underlying sample contains only names surviving to 2026.
